themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties in Spain, Italy, and Sweden are intensifying efforts to implement 'national priority' policies, which prioritize citizens over immigrants in access to social services, housing, and employment. This theme reflects a coordinated transnational strategy to embed exclusionary policies at local and regional levels.
